Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 7

“My nature is overcome by the flaw of pity, my mind bewildered about duty — I ask you: tell me decisively what is best. I am your student; instruct me, for I take refuge in you.”

The turning point of the Gita. Arjuna stops arguing and formally becomes a student. Everything Krishna says afterward is answering a question that was genuinely asked, not advice pressed on someone unwilling.
